harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native-machine-tv-recheck route on a real mumei.native-bundle/v1 built from branch and call atoms. This source includes a direct call inside a conditional branch, forward branches, and an acyclic backward branch; the Core descriptor performs direct-call-site, forward-branch, acyclic-branch, and conditional-call TV. Conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching, while direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites. Cyclic control flow and loops remain outside. Function outcomes are aggregate-only; the register convention is assumed, not verified. There is no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim; object_translation_correspondence remains unperformed, and a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read scenarios/native_machine_tv_branch_call_recheck/src/main.mm, which combines the #1210 conditional-call and #1209 acyclic-branch real-Core integration source shapes.
Step 1 builds a real native bundle, verifies its pinned exit status and empty stdout/stderr digests, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the build ID.

Step 2 runs native-machine-tv-recheck and asserts Core performs machine_code_direct_call_site_tv, machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv, machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv, and machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv for this source. Conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching; direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites. Function outcomes are aggregate without function names, the register convention is assumed rather than verified, and full object TV remains outside the profile.

Step 3 reruns with a wrong build ID and asserts no machine-TV outcome, no selected result, full C02/object checks_not_performed including machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv, machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv, machine_code_direct_call_site_tv, and machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv, and normalized exit_code 1.

intro: Step 1: Build a bundle with branch/call inputs.
Step 2: Recheck the declared machine-TV fields.
Step 3: Try a mismatched build ID.
narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-machine-tv-recheck route on a real native bundle whose source includes a direct call within a conditional branch, forward branches, and an acyclic backward branch. Core performs the direct-call-site, forward-branch, acyclic-branch, and conditional-call checks; conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching, while direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites. Function outcomes are aggregate-only without function names; cyclic control flow and loops remain outside. The register convention is assumed, not verified; there is no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim; and object_translation_correspondence stays unperformed. A wrong build ID must not produce a selected outcome.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1 with machine_tv_recheck == 'checked', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], checks_not_performed == ['file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], machine_tv_schema == 'mumei.machine-code-tv/v1', register_convention_assumed == 'sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_result_rax', function_outcomes == {'equivalent_within_profile': 5, 'outside_profile': 1}, no function names in the report, a selected_result and no candidate

wrong_report.json carries no machine_tv_recheck or discharged_checks, checks_not_performed == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with pinned outputs
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_branch_call_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==7, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins program exit status 7 and empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds the declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the record pins program exit status 7 and both output channels.

steps.name: native-machine-tv-recheck reports the bounded branch-aware profile
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_branch_call_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['machine_tv_recheck']=='checked', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['machine_tv_schema']=='mumei.machine-code-tv/v1', r; assert r['register_convention_assumed']=='sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_result_rax', r; assert r['function_outcomes']=={'equivalent_within_profile':5,'outside_profile':1}, r; text=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True); assert not any(json.dumps(name) in text for name in ('helper','cc','absd','band','main','__mumei_user_main')), text; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('native-machine-tv-recheck: direct-call, forward-branch, acyclic-branch, and conditional-call checks performed; conditional calls match per-path under guards; direct calls are uninterpreted sites; cyclic control flow and loops outside; no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json carries the matching machine-TV schema and assumed register convention, aggregate function outcomes without function names, a selected result, and the exact observed discharged_checks for leaf, direct-call-site, forward-branch, acyclic-branch, and conditional-call TV; checks_not_performed includes object_translation_correspondence and the other observed unperformed checks. Conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching; cyclic control flow and loops stay outside, direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites, and full object TV remains unperformed.
steps.verifier_gate: native-machine-tv-recheck exits 0 with the matching build ID; the report claims only the checks listed by Core, uses per-path guarded call matching for conditional calls, treats direct calls as uninterpreted call sites, leaves cyclic control flow and loops outside, exposes only aggregate function outcomes, and makes no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no machine-TV outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_branch_call_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'machine_tv_recheck' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code')==1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no machine-TV outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json carries no machine_tv_recheck, no discharged_checks, the sorted full C02/object checks_not_performed vocabulary including machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv, machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv, machine_code_direct_call_site_tv, machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv, and machine_code_leaf_function_tv, no selected_result, and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: A mismatched build ID exits 1 and produces no claimed machine-TV outcome.
